g.text: Change in the number of vehicles since 2017

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2428

g.text: Automobiles and light trucks by fuel, Québec, 2011–2024

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Solid: published counts, 2017–2022. Dashed with hollow points: inferred from make, model and model year.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Type AU only (automobiles and light trucks), businesses included. Before 2017 the type is published and the fuel inferred; for 2023–2024 both are inferred. On published years, all vehicle types together, the forward inference is within 0.5 % for

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: gasoline and runs 4 to 19 % low for electric; the backward one is within 6 %. Other fuels (propane, natural gas, not stated) are left out.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; fill: #5f6b74

g.text: Sources: SAAQ, open data « Véhicules en circulation », 2011–2022 (files of December 18, 2023); SAAQ, files released under the access Act, file 03.06.34729 (decision of September 17, 2025), 2023–2024.
